issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
A trial of this host before a real round, nothing else: check that worlds made from the given worlds start with the images this host has.

The position that keeps the held-out tasks (it holds the worlds-heldout resource) does all of it; the other positions have nothing to do in this world and end their turns at once.

1. For each of rw_5c4743418b6b, rw_686e5b0bd6da and rw_e263f2a52297 (state root issue-396-heldout) and rw_313df9cf84a4 (state root issue-312-target), make a world of your own continued from its checkpoint c0. Its configuration is that world's own (`config show`) with only these changed: the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo are the cand-g2 files in /initial-state/inputs/1/cand-g2/; worker.image and worker.environment_image are the full image IDs /initial-state/inputs/1/README.md lists for that paper; "resources": []; budget.total_seconds 900; worker.max_executions 1; worker.max_model_seconds 300.
2. Drive only the continuation of rw_686e5b0bd6da, for its one turn (`execute <world> --loop`), and wait for it to end. Do not drive the other three.
3. Then end all four worlds you made (`finish`).
4. Push one file, trial.md, to your repository's main: for each of the four, the command you ran, whether it was accepted (the refusal word for word if not), its world id, and for the driven one its turn's outcome and whether paper-repo's turn started in its environment with /workspace/input present.

No judging, no release.
